methodology.description: Independent manually authored synthetic query-holdout, not document-holdout or real-user traffic; not training data.
methodology.label_semantics: Any listed page is useful; labels are alternatives, not exhaustive set recall.
methodology.scope: Independent manually authored synthetic query-holdout, not document-holdout or real user traffic. No training is performed here.
methodology.output_contracts: Native returns compact paths; unchanged Python emits signatures/snippets and metadata. Timings compare end-to-end CLIs, not isolated scorers.
methodology.memory: Per-child peak RSS from os.wait4 on Linux; no cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum.
methodology.native_ranking: Recommended default: native BM25 with structural/alias recall; --bm25-only is an explicit alias.
methodology.learned_ranking: Frozen experimental model, enabled only by --learned-ranker. Independent holdout favored BM25; used for algorithm selection, never weight/alias tuning.
methodology.timing: Cold means a fresh process with index/database load, not a flushed OS filesystem cache. Batch latency is not per-query warm latency. CPU/RSS samples are per child.
